summary: Enhancement Shaman should prioritize poison cleansing and a self snare-removal option for Altar of Fangs.
recommendations: Talent Poison Cleansing Totem as a recovery tool for Envenom and Mass Envenom.
Bring an eligible snare-removal option for Paralyzing Shots.
Do not talent Purge solely for this dungeon based on the current Enhancement guide recommendation.
Use Wind Shear on priority casts, coordinating coverage for repeated Toxic Atrophy casts.

provenance.description: Original build-scoped summary derived from targeted review of Wowhead's Enhancement Shaman Midnight Season 2 dungeon guide.
